quests.question: This person wears safety goggles and does experiments to learn new things. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person wears safety goggles and does experiments to learn new things. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a scientist. Scientists ask questions and do experiments to learn how the world works.
quests.funFact: Scientists sometimes repeat the same experiment many times to be sure of the answer.
quests.wordExample: The scientist mixed two liquids to see what would happen.

quests.question: This person designs and builds fun new toys for children to play with. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person designs and builds fun new toys for children to play with. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a toy maker. Toy makers design and build fun toys for children.
quests.funFact: A toy maker might build hundreds of toys before choosing the best design!
quests.wordExample: The toy maker built a wooden train for the toy shop.

quests.question: This person films and shares videos about their stories and ideas. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person films and shares videos about their stories and ideas. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a vlogger. Vloggers record videos to share stories and ideas online.
quests.funFact: A vlogger might film and edit a video for hours before sharing it!
quests.wordExample: The vlogger filmed a video about her trip.

quests.question: This person studies old documents and objects to learn what happened long ago. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person studies old documents and objects to learn what happened long ago. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a historian. Historians study events from the past to understand history.
quests.funFact: A historian can piece together what happened long ago from old letters and objects.
quests.wordExample: The historian explained how people lived long ago.

quests.question: This scientist studies birds and can often name one just by its song. Who is it?
quests.hint: This scientist studies birds and can often name one just by its song. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an ornithologist. Ornithologists study birds and their behavior.
quests.funFact: An ornithologist can often identify a bird just by hearing its song!
quests.wordExample: The ornithologist watched the birds through binoculars.

quests.question: This person sits at the front of the train and drives it safely along the tracks. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person sits at the front of the train and drives it safely along the tracks. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a train driver. Train drivers safely drive trains along the tracks.
quests.funFact: A train driver has to know every station along a very long route!
quests.wordExample: The train driver announced the next station.

quests.question: This person studies old records to trace a family's history. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person studies old records to trace a family's history. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a genealogist. Genealogists research family history and trace family trees.
quests.funFact: A genealogist can trace a family's story back hundreds of years!
quests.wordExample: The genealogist traced our family back three generations.

quests.question: This person plays an instrument, like a guitar or piano, to make music. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person plays an instrument, like a guitar or piano, to make music. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a musician. Musicians play instruments to create music.
quests.funFact: Some musicians can play more than one instrument really well.
quests.wordExample: The musician practiced the drums every afternoon.

quests.question: This person helps you find and borrow the perfect book at the library. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person helps you find and borrow the perfect book at the library. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a librarian. Librarians help people find and borrow books at the library.
quests.funFact: A librarian can help you find one book among thousands on the shelves!
quests.wordExample: The librarian helped me find a book about dinosaurs.

quests.question: This person uses math and science to design machines, roads, or bridges. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person uses math and science to design machines, roads, or bridges. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Nice work! This is an engineer. Engineers design and build machines, roads, and other useful things.
quests.funFact: Engineers use math and science together to solve everyday problems.
quests.wordExample: The engineer designed a stronger bridge for the town.

quests.question: This person researches facts and asks questions to write true news stories. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person researches facts and asks questions to write true news stories. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Nice work! This is a journalist. Journalists research and write news stories for newspapers or TV.
quests.funFact: A journalist checks facts carefully before sharing a story.
quests.wordExample: The journalist interviewed the mayor about the new park.

quests.question: This person takes your order and brings your food to the table at a restaurant. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person takes your order and brings your food to the table at a restaurant. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a waiter. Waiters bring food and drinks to your table at a restaurant.
quests.funFact: A busy waiter can remember many food orders at the same time!
quests.wordExample: The waiter brought our food to the table.

quests.question: This person writes original music by imagining a melody and writing it down. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person writes original music by imagining a melody and writing it down. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a composer. Composers write original music for others to play or sing.
quests.funFact: Some famous composers wrote music that orchestras still play today.
quests.wordExample: The composer played the melody on the piano first.

quests.question: This person memorizes lines and pretends to be a character in a play or movie. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person memorizes lines and pretends to be a character in a play or movie. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an actor. Actors perform in movies, plays, or TV shows.
quests.funFact: An actor might memorize dozens of pages of lines for one show!
quests.wordExample: The actor performed on stage in front of a big crowd.

quests.question: This person tests your eyes and helps you pick the right glasses. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person tests your eyes and helps you pick the right glasses. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an optician. Opticians test people's eyes and help them choose the right glasses.
quests.funFact: An optician uses a special chart with letters that get smaller and smaller.
quests.wordExample: The optician tested my eyes and picked out new glasses.

quests.question: This person wears a thick glove and trains a falcon to fly out and return. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person wears a thick glove and trains a falcon to fly out and return. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a falconer. Falconers train and care for falcons and other birds of prey.
quests.funFact: A falconer wears a thick leather glove so a falcon can land safely on their arm!
quests.wordExample: The falconer's bird flew out and returned to her glove.

quests.question: This person drives a big truck that clears snow off the roads. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person drives a big truck that clears snow off the roads. Who is it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a snow plow driver. Snow plow drivers clear snow from roads after a snowstorm.
quests.funFact: Snow plow drivers help keep everyone safe on icy, snowy roads.
quests.wordExample: The snow plow driver pushed the snow off to the side.

quests.question: This person makes and repairs shoes, stitching leather back together. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person makes and repairs shoes, stitching leather back together. Who is it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a cobbler. Cobblers make and repair shoes.
quests.funFact: Cobblers once made every single pair of shoes in a town by hand.
quests.wordExample: The cobbler stitched the torn shoe back together.

quests.question: This person trains hard, works as part of a team, and helps protect their country. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person trains hard, works as part of a team, and helps protect their country. Who is it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a soldier. Soldiers train hard and work together to protect their country.
quests.funFact: Soldiers often work together in teams to complete a task.
quests.wordExample: The soldiers marched together in a straight line.

quests.question: This person drives from house to house, delivering packages to front doors. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person drives from house to house, delivering packages to front doors. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a delivery driver. Delivery drivers bring packages straight to your front door.
quests.funFact: A delivery driver might drop off hundreds of packages in one day!
quests.wordExample: The delivery driver left a package on our porch.

quests.question: This person guides the actors and crew and calls "action!" to make a movie. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person guides the actors and crew and calls "action!" to make a movie. Who is it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a film director. Film directors guide the actors and crew to make a movie.
quests.funFact: Film directors work closely with hundreds of people to make one movie.
quests.wordExample: The film director explained the scene to the actors.

quests.question: This person takes care of animals that are sick or hurt, like a puppy with a hurt paw. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person takes care of animals that are sick or hurt, like a puppy with a hurt paw. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Nice work! This is a vet. Vets take care of sick or hurt animals.
quests.funFact: A vet might care for a tiny hamster and a huge horse on the same day!
quests.wordExample: We took our puppy to the vet for its check-up.

quests.question: This person's name is printed on the cover of the book they spent months writing. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person's name is printed on the cover of the book they spent months writing. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is an author. Authors write books for people to read and enjoy.
quests.funFact: Some authors write the same story over and over until it feels just right.
quests.wordExample: The author read the first chapter aloud to the class.

quests.question: This person uses a saw and hammer to build and fix things made of wood. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person uses a saw and hammer to build and fix things made of wood. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a carpenter. Carpenters build and fix things made of wood, like tables and doors.
quests.funFact: A skilled carpenter can build a wooden table without using a single nail!
quests.wordExample: The carpenter built a wooden chair for the kitchen.

quests.question: This person practices flips, jumps, and balances that take years to master. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person practices flips, jumps, and balances that take years to master. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a gymnast. Gymnasts perform flips, jumps, and balances that take years of practice.
quests.funFact: A gymnast can balance on a beam thinner than a shoe!
quests.wordExample: The gymnast did a perfect cartwheel across the mat.

quests.question: This person wears a helmet with a light and digs deep underground. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person wears a helmet with a light and digs deep underground. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a miner. Miners dig deep underground to find coal, metal, or gems.
quests.funFact: Miners wear a helmet with a bright light to see underground.
quests.wordExample: The miner wore a helmet with a bright light on it.

quests.question: This person plans workouts and helps one person exercise safely. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person plans workouts and helps one person exercise safely. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a personal trainer. Personal trainers help one person exercise safely and reach their fitness goals.
quests.funFact: Personal trainers cheer their clients on to help them try their best.
quests.wordExample: The personal trainer planned a new workout for the week.

quests.question: This person stacks bricks or stones to build a strong wall. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person stacks bricks or stones to build a strong wall. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Nice work! This is a mason. Masons build walls and structures using brick or stone.
quests.funFact: A mason lines up each brick so carefully that walls stay strong for years!
quests.wordExample: The mason stacked bricks to build a garden wall.

quests.question: This person makes and serves coffee and other drinks at a cafe. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person makes and serves coffee and other drinks at a cafe. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a barista. Baristas make and serve coffee and other drinks at a cafe.
quests.funFact: A skilled barista can pour a pretty leaf pattern into warm milk!
quests.wordExample: The barista made a warm drink for my mom.

quests.question: This person watches over one building or place and keeps it safe. Who is it?
quests.hint: This person watches over one building or place and keeps it safe. Who is it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a security guard. Security guards watch over a place and keep people and things safe.
quests.funFact: A security guard often walks the same building many times each night.
quests.wordExample: The security guard checked every door before locking up.
